name: Code Review
summary: Review a pull request or a set of code changes for bugs, logic errors, and project-convention violations using a confidence-filtered, multi-agent process. Use this skill when the user asks to review a PR, audit pending changes, or inspect a diff for problems before merging.

name: Security Review
summary: Perform a focused security review of pending git changes to identify high-confidence security vulnerabilities with real exploitation potential. Use this skill when the user asks for a security review, security audit, vulnerability scan, or wants to check pending changes on a branch for security issues before merging. This is NOT a general code review.
